projects.title: Normal reopen and explicit reset
projects.completeScope: Implement explicit reset vs normal initialisation for the supplied real SQLite notes table; normal close/reopen preserves marker and one seed, reset removes marker.
requiredEvidence: Owned temporary-file cleanup and durability limit
projects.minute_scope: Historical bounded-target allocation; not a measured full learning route.
semanticStages: Identify schema, seed and data ownership
Preserve rows on the normal path
Reserve data removal for explicit reset
Cross the file reopen boundary and explain cleanup

projects.title: Closed query translator
projects.completeScope: Parse owner, true/false archived and title/id sort tokens only, return parameterised WHERE bindings and fixed order SQL, reject unknown/invalid tokens.
projects.minute_scope: Historical bounded-target allocation; not a measured full learning route.
semanticStages: Validate the closed public query language
Choose fixed order clauses and resolve ties
Connect query choices to real rows and refusals

projects.title: Awaited reservation persistence
projects.completeScope: Validate/trim code, await the supplied delayed real SQLite write, return detached saved data and map only the declared conflict error while preserving unexpected errors.
projects.minute_scope: Historical bounded-target allocation; not a measured full learning route.
semanticStages: Validate owned input before requesting a write
Keep completion pending until the adapter settles
Project a fresh result from the saved row
Map only the declared conflict and retain other errors

limitation: These complete bounded SQLite tasks use Node built-in DatabaseSync and a supplied asynchronous adapter. They do not complete or qualify the original Sequelize/sqlite3 implementation. Same-process reopen is not crash durability.
